agent: browser pull through the author's desktop Chrome; fetch() run in a page on each service's own origin, results returned as page text and transcribed; every line checked against a checksum computed in the page

enc-coalne-eastfacing.txt.scale_band: harbour (usage band 5). The berthing band (enc_berthing/MapServer/37) returned 0 features in both boxes; approach (layer 88) and coastal (layer 70) are smaller-scale and were not used.
enc-coalne-eastfacing.txt.reduction: Kept only vertices with no other coastline segment crossing their latitude to the east (ray cast east within the same pull), grouped into runs along each feature: 1,491 Palm Beach and 357 Hollywood vertices.

source: https://encdirect.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/encdirect/enc_harbour/MapServer/237 (Sea_Area_Named_Water_Area), OBJNAM 'Jupiter Inlet', cell US5FL6EN, taken from the Palm Beach box pull
https://encdirect.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/encdirect/enc_harbour/MapServer/85, 141, 87, 233 (SLCONS line, BRIDGE area and line, LNDARE)
enc-inlets-jupiter-boynton.txt.note: LNDARE rings were clipped to the Boynton box in the browser (Sutherland-Hodgman). The chart has no named SEAARE for South Lake Worth Inlet. Bridges inside the Jupiter Inlet area were listed (enc_harbour/MapServer/141) to place the first bridge at 80.0852 to 80.0847 W.

tiger-hollywood-hallandale.txt.note: Rings clipped in the browser to lon -80.135 to -80.095, lat 25.965 to 26.075. Only the Hallandale Beach ring and the main Hollywood ring (256 vertices) were transcribed.

nhd-lowerkeys-canal-centrelines.txt.selection: ftype 336 flowlines plus ftype 558 flowlines whose middle vertex is inside an FTYPE 336 area; 508 lines, 81.5 km before simplification; Douglas-Peucker 0.00004 deg; 1e-5 deg delta encoding; field 2 is M for City of Marathon, U for unincorporated (TIGERweb places point-in-polygon).
nhd-lowerkeys-canal-centrelines.txt.comparison_with_osm: OSM mon26 set 122 lines, 34.9 km. 17.8 km of it lies inside an NHD canal area or within 25 m of an NHD centreline. Of the 17.2 km not matched, 6.7 km is inside the City of Key West (outside Monroe § 26-5) and 10.5 km is in unincorporated county, mostly long lines around the Key West island group.
